findings.location: line 2 ("The things that are bad will all be in hell.")
findings.source_quote: The things that are bad will all be in hell.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the clause to explicitly reflect "in hell" (inferno/naqueles que estão no inferno), not a vague or different concept. For example: "As coisas más ficarão todas no inferno."
findings.translation_quote: As coisas más ficarão todas no além.

findings.location: line 4 ("We are in a battle; we must still overcome.")
findings.source_quote: We are in a battle; we must still overcome.
findings.suggested_fix: Render the obligation and present-tense struggle without adding extraneous eschatological detail. For example: "Estamos numa batalha; ainda precisamos vencer." Do not add "na vida vindoura" or other time qualifiers that change the meaning.
findings.translation_quote: Estamos numa batalha; ainda precisamos vencer na vida vindoura.

findings.location: line 8 ("For he knows very well it will cost us our soul.")
findings.source_quote: For he knows very well it will cost us our soul.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate "our soul" without adding adjectives not present in the source. For example: "Pois sabe muito bem que isso nos custará a alma." Remove the added adjective "imortal."
findings.translation_quote: Pois sabe muito bem que isso nos custará a alma imortal.

findings.location: line 6 ("He spreads all his lies, the truth to distort.")
findings.source_quote: He spreads all his lies, the truth to distort.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the phrase clearly and idiomatically, keeping the sense of "distorting the truth." For example: "Espalha todas as suas mentiras, para distorcer a verdade." Remove the added and unclear phrase "por insulto."
findings.translation_quote: Espalha todas as suas mentiras, a verdade distorce por insulto.

findings.location: line 10 ("He’ll trick and deceive, each soul to pursue.")
findings.source_quote: He’ll trick and deceive, each soul to pursue.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the deliberate object ("cada alma" or "cada pessoa") and the sense of pursuing souls; do not introduce unrelated words. For example: "Ele enganará e iludirá, perseguindo cada alma." Replace the incorrect insertion "com casta."
findings.translation_quote: Ele enganará e iludirá, perseguindo cada vida com casta.

findings.location: lines 13–14 ("To find one perfect, His power He’ll show!")
findings.source_quote: To find one perfect, His power He’ll show!
findings.suggested_fix: Translate without adding idiomatic flourishes that change tone. For example: "Para encontrar um perfeito, Seu poder então mostrará." Remove the added qualifier "com gosto."
findings.translation_quote: Para achar um perfeito; Seu poder então mostrará com gosto.

findings.location: final line ("Let’s take hold of God’s power! It’s time to respond!")
findings.source_quote: Let’s take hold of God’s power! It’s time to respond!
findings.suggested_fix: Translate both exclamations faithfully without adding extra liturgical particles. For example: "Tomemos o poder de Deus! É tempo de responder!" Remove the added interjection "amém!" unless it appears in the source.
findings.translation_quote: Tomemos o poder de Deus! É tempo de responder, amém!
